findings.title: Lab job API is a single point of failure for lab-dependent work
evidence: runbooks/LAB_API.md and AGENTS.md:21-23 make lab preflight required for lab work
no secondary endpoint or queue in lab_runner.py
findings.impact: If ci-runner is down, every lab-dependent audit/remediation step blocks with no failover.
findings.recommendation: Document a local MODE=local fallback per audit, or add a second runner/queue.

report: Assessed failure modes of the lab job API and the run pipeline. The API is a single systemd service; git remains the durable store for runs.
